BITUMEN BUYER FAQ
BITUMEN SUPPLY FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

LAST REVIEWED SEPTEMBER 10, 2026 · PETROBIND EXPORT DESK

Practical FAQ for procurement teams, contractors, distributors, and import buyers buying bitumen 60/70, oxidized grades, emulsions, and VG grades. Covers grade selection, packaging, documents, Incoterms, and how to structure a meaningful RFQ.

Request Bitumen Quote
View Bitumen Grades
MAIN PRODUCT FAMILIES

PetroBind supports penetration and viscosity-grade bitumen, polymer modified bitumen, oxidized bitumen, and bitumen emulsion. Each family has different handling, application, and documentation needs.

FASTEST WAY TO GET A MEANINGFUL QUOTE

Send the grade, quantity, destination port, packing preference, Incoterm, timing, and any tender specification. A complete RFQ helps avoid vague offers and repeated clarification.
